pages.text: Select entities inside a sphere with the specified radius.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Each query costs 50 + 2*V, where V is scan volume. Lines and arcs add their sample queries.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1. Scan range and target count do not change complexity.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: Using This Node
pages.text: You do not need to attach any more nodes here. Insert it, then select it to adjust its settings on the right. Right-click it on the canvas to take it back.
